description: Hi! I’m a middle school student passionate about space exploration, creative storytelling, and Mars science. I created the Martian Survival Map to make space survival fun and easy to understand, and teamed up with a friend so we can share this NASA challenge experience together!
summary: The Martian Survival Map is a fun, easy-to-understand survival guide designed by a middle school student to help future astronauts stay safe on Mars. Using real planetary data and imagery from NASA missions (like the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter and Viking), this project highlights the biggest environmental hazards on the Red Planet—including freezing temperatures, toxic air, deadly radiation, and giant dust storms. Through a custom survival map and illustrated guide, the project explores four major Martian landmarks: Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Jezero Crater, and Korolev Crater. For each spot, the guide breaks down the specific dangers, hidden benefits, and practical survival tips so explorers know how to stay alive while making space science engaging and humorous. AI Disclosure: An AI assistant was used to help draft and edit the text descriptions based on the creator's original ideas, humor, and NASA data research.
details: • I created the original concept for the Martian Survival Map, designed the presentation, and added my own humor and edits. I used an AI assistant to help suggest the four Martian landmarks (Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Jezero Crater, and Korolev Crater) and to draft the scientific descriptions and survival tips based on NASA Mars mission data.
